scope: Static source audit of MassNavigation simulation paths. Timing causation remains unmeasured unless stated.

effective_10k_config.status: Exact committed base config, not a claim that an instrumented runtime has no overrides

findings.title: Local steering scans every occupant even after the neighbor scratch limit is reached, and scans every obstacle for every active unit
findings.call_chain: GameEngine.Tick:4896-4945 -> RealtimePacemaker.Update (IPacemaker.cs:89-98) -> PhaseOrderedCooperativeSimulation.Step:33-75 -> PostMovement systems registered by MassNavigationRuntime:131-140 -> MassNavigationSimulationStepSystem.Update:45-80 -> MassNavigationSimulationRuntime.CadenceScheduler.NextSimulationStep -> MassNavigationFlowSolverState.Step:932-1047 -> StepRange:1677 -> separation hash bucket loops:1962-1970 -> occupant checks:1970-2009; then obstacle loop:2013-2034; settled/time-held early hold only at 2042-2048.
findings.frequency: 15 simulation steps per simulation-second with committed config; one StepRange partition per scheduled worker but total outer iterations N, not N*workers. At 1K serial; 5K/10K use up to 8 workers (parallel threshold 2048). Render frames can contain zero/one/multiple logical steps.
findings.complexity: O(N + B + P_local + N*O) per step. P_local is actual occupants in each agent's searched hash cells. A dense cell can produce N*(N-1) directed visits. MaxNeighbors only limits writes to _avoidanceNeighborScratch at 1980-1984; it does not stop the 1986-2005 arithmetic. Obstacle work is N*ObstacleCount even for agents that later hold position.
findings.gc: No managed allocation is visible in these loops; arrays and scratch are preallocated. Scheduler allocation classification is separate and not inferred here.
findings.ecs_structure: None in StepRange; this is solver-owned SoA. Entity structural changes are not performed.
findings.capacity_behavior: Separation hash stores all N agents in preallocated arrays; no per-cell truncation. Obstacle snapshots reject count > _maxObstacleCount (64) at MassNavigationFlowSolverState.cs:612-618 with InvalidOperationException.
findings.why_10k: At 10,000 units, even a modest local occupancy multiplies directed pair work by 10,000. With 64 obstacles the unconditional obstacle loop adds up to 640,000 distance checks per simulation step; stationary units still pay this cost because the hold branch is after both scans.
findings.introduced_by_target: Retained from pre-PR implementation; ac8ab86af0 changed hard-candidate gating and removed a fallback hard scan, but did not change these StepRange loops.
findings.ab_method: Run identical 1K/5K/10K scenes with (A) current code and (B) an instrumented build that counts bucket occupants and obstacle iterations, then a semantics-preserving spatial obstacle broad phase or a bounded occupant iterator. Capture StepPrep/LocalSteering ms, pair checks, obstacle checks, and allocations for static sparse, static dense, moving sparse, and moving dense. Falsify as a primary cause if steering ms and counted checks do not scale with P_local or N*O, or if replacing the loops changes neither timing nor frame time within measurement error. Do not skip settled scans without a wake-up correctness test.
findings.evidence_status: Source-verified work pattern; timing impact UNMEASURED, no runtime A/B performed by this audit

ten_k_worst_case_arithmetic.note: Arithmetic bounds only; not observed production counts. Existing dense production-layout test expects hard pairs <12N.

findings.title: Flow rebuild copies a full grid and recomputes an obstacle stencil for every flow state; enabled=false still computes flow
findings.call_chain: GameEngine.Tick:4896-4945 -> RealtimePacemaker.Update (IPacemaker.cs:89-98) -> PhaseOrderedCooperativeSimulation.Step:33-75 -> PostMovement systems registered by MassNavigationRuntime:131-140 -> MassNavigationSimulationStepSystem.Update:61-69 -> MassNavigationFlowSolverState.AdvanceFlowPipeline -> AdvanceFlowPipelineCore:1066-1090 -> ComputeFlowFields:1359-1367 -> RebuildFlowCostForState:1398-1403 (Array.Copy) -> ComputeFlow:1540-1605. Obstacle refresh calls RebuildStaticObstacleCost:1385-1396 -> IsObstacle (all configured obstacles). ForceFlowRebuild:1376-1382 uses the same path.
findings.frequency: Warm stable config: FlowStepHz=5 and FlowCrowdStampHz=5 are coincident triggers; FlowObstacleStampHz=2 is another trigger. Each triggered refresh can recompute all F flow states even when tuning.enabled=false. With aligned zero remainders and 15 simulation steps/second, expected refresh steps are 3,6,8,9,12,15 (6 rebuilds/s); dirty/window/profile changes can add rebuilds. Cold Reset/ResetAuthoredAgents/ResetRuntimeObstaclesFromWorld use ForceFlowRebuild separately. No rebuild when _flowDirty=false and all cadence flags=false (1072-1074).
findings.complexity: For F flow states and G grid cells: O(G*O) on static obstacle refresh + O(F*G) full cost copies + O(F*G*R^2) flow stencil, where G=10000 and R=FlowObstacleNeighborRadiusCells (4 => up to 80 neighbor offsets per cell). Crowd stamping adds O(F*min(N,budget)*9).
findings.gc: Array.Copy and numeric loops allocate no managed objects; flow-state creation is a cold/configuration event and may allocate large arrays.
findings.ecs_structure: No ECS structural changes in rebuild; operates on solver arrays.
findings.capacity_behavior: G is fixed by solver dimensions. Agent arrays locked to configured capacity. ResolveFlowStateIndex:2684-2707 scans F and, only on allowCreate=true cold/binding calls, creates FlowRuntimeState plus 2G float array; List may grow. Unknown combination with allowCreate=false throws explicitly. No independent configurable F limit was found in this method, so many team/layer combinations are an event-capacity concern, not demonstrated 10K steady allocation.
findings.why_10k: A 100x100 field means every rebuild touches 10,000 cells per flow state. Four team flow states repeat the copy and stencil. crowdStampBudget=0 (the path used by ForceFlowRebuild and also when FlowTuning.Enabled is false) skips crowd stamping only; it does not skip Array.Copy or ComputeFlow.
findings.introduced_by_target: Retained implementation; target only adds telemetry accessors around simulation. No target diff removes the repeated copy/stencil.
findings.ab_method: First count actual F, refresh reasons, full-grid cells and obstacle-stencil visits with committed cadence, for static and moving 1K/5K/10K. Compare A=current with B=cache the blocked-cell avoidance vector once per obstacle revision while crowd stamping is disabled; preserve target vector calculation and identical output vectors. Compare steady snapshots with all three flow cadences set to 0 after initial rebuild as an explicitly frozen-navigation diagnostic control, not a shipping fix. Falsify performance relevance if per-refresh cost and total frame time do not decline beyond run variance. When crowd stamping is enabled, share only data whose blocked-cell classification is proven equal across interaction domains.
findings.evidence_status: Source-verified work pattern; timing impact UNMEASURED, no runtime A/B performed by this audit
findings.enabled_false_contract: At 1090 Enabled only selects crowd stamp budget: false=>0. ComputeFlowFields still loops F and calls both RebuildFlowCostForState and ComputeFlow. The enabled flag is not a total flow or MassNavigation disable switch.

findings.title: Every simulation step copies position/velocity snapshots and scans all units for dirty ECS synchronization
findings.call_chain: GameEngine.Tick:4896-4945 -> RealtimePacemaker.Update (IPacemaker.cs:89-98) -> PhaseOrderedCooperativeSimulation.Step:33-75 -> PostMovement systems registered by MassNavigationRuntime:131-140 -> StepSystem.Update:45-80 -> FlowSolverState.Step:947-974 Array.Copy(_positionsCm/_velocitiesCm) -> steering/hard resolve -> UpdateSettledUnitCount -> MarkMovedEntitiesDirty:1521-1538 (full N scan) -> on entity-sync cadence StepSystem:83-91 -> SyncDisplacedAgentPoses + SyncEntities:10-58, each dirty entity does world.IsAlive and world.Get<WorldPositionCm>.
findings.frequency: Snapshot copies and MarkMovedEntitiesDirty execute every simulation step. SyncEntities executes only when EntitySyncHz distributor fires, over D dirty agents; MarkAllEntitiesDirty can enqueue all N after a reset/window change.
findings.complexity: Two copies, each of 2N float elements: 2 copies * 2N * 4 bytes = 16N bytes of payload per simulation step (source read plus destination write traffic is about 32N bytes). Types are float[] at FlowSolverState:56-59, not Vector2[]. Plus O(N) dirty comparison and O(D) random ECS writes. BuildBucketHash adds O(N+B) count clear/prefix/two population passes every step, plus hard-hash rebuild on hard ticks.
findings.gc: Array.Copy, flag scans, and dirty-list writes use preallocated arrays; no per-step managed allocation observed. ECS world.Get/IsAlive do not imply GC.
findings.ecs_structure: SyncEntities writes existing WorldPositionCm only; it performs no Add/Remove/Create/Destroy. Structural changes occur in separate binding/rebuild paths, not this steady loop.
findings.capacity_behavior: Dirty arrays are sized with solver capacity. MarkEntityDirty deduplicates via byte flags; exceeding configured agent capacity is rejected during preallocation/reset rather than resized in the hot loop.
findings.why_10k: At 10K, each simulation step copies about 160 KB of position/velocity payload and performs 10K movement comparisons even if no unit moved. A full dirty sync adds 10K ECS lookups/writes and can compete with presentation cache locality.
findings.introduced_by_target: Retained from pre-PR solver; target adds observer timing only. Entity sync code was not structurally changed by 91618843a4.
findings.ab_method: EntitySyncHz=0 is a valid config value (MassNavigationCadenceConfig.Validate:26 uses allowZero:true). Use it only as a short diagnostic control that intentionally freezes ECS writeback, with simulation state captured and reset identically; it is not a semantics-preserving fix. Main corrective A/B should compare current dirty-index ECS writes with a Chunk/Inline Query writeback keyed by existing stable solver index, at D=0, sparse D, and D=N; compare exact final WorldPositionCm. Measure prep, sync, whole-frame timing and current-thread/all-worker allocation separately. Snapshot removal requires a double-buffer or equivalent preservation of read consistency and the dirty-change reference state.
findings.evidence_status: Source-verified work pattern; timing impact UNMEASURED, no runtime A/B performed by this audit

findings.title: Hard resolve is spatially bounded by searched buckets but remains quadratic for a dense candidate bucket
findings.evidence_status: Source-verified bound; current 10K production pair count and timing UNMEASURED
findings.call_chain: GameEngine.Tick:4896-4945 -> RealtimePacemaker.Update (IPacemaker.cs:89-98) -> PhaseOrderedCooperativeSimulation.Step:33-75 -> PostMovement systems registered by MassNavigationRuntime:131-140 -> MassNavigationSimulationStepSystem.Update:72-80 -> FlowSolverState.Step:989-992 or 1039-1042 -> ResolveHardPenetration:2445 -> BuildHardResolveHash:2460 -> candidate count:2467 -> candidate-agent hash neighborhoods:2494-2519 -> ResolveObstaclePenetration:2619-2649.
findings.frequency: Committed HardResolveHz=10 per simulation-second. Hash rebuild and N candidate count scan happen even if candidate count becomes zero.
findings.complexity: O(N+B_hard+P_hard+C*O). Candidate gate skips noncandidate agents; j>i avoids duplicate unordered checks. In a bucket containing all candidates, worst P_hard=N*(N-1)/2. At N=10K the arithmetic bound is 49,995,000, not an observed production count.
findings.gc: No managed allocation visible in hard loops or bucket rebuild; buffers preallocated.
findings.ecs_structure: None. SeparateAgents writes solver-owned position/velocity arrays.
findings.capacity_behavior: Per-cell membership is uncapped and never silently truncated; total agent arrays use configured locked capacity. Current obstacle count above configured max throws.
findings.introduced_by_target: ac8ab86af0 removed the old noncandidate fallback neighborhood probe and reduced physical collision hash radius. This is an improvement, not a newly introduced quadratic scan. New LastHardResolveCandidateAgentCount adds one O(N) byte sum only on hard ticks.
findings.why_10k: Cost follows actual occupancy and candidates rather than just total population. Dense crowds can dominate a frame even with 0 allocation; sparse settled crowds should have zero hard pairs after ac8.
findings.ab_method: Replay identical seeded 1K/5K/10K production dense and sparse layouts at ac8 parent and ac8/target. Record candidates, hard pairs, penetrating pairs, max overlap and hard ms per actual hard tick. Existing tests at MassNavigationFlowSolverStateConfigurationTests:349-443 provide fixtures but are single-worker microtests, not whole-frame evidence. Falsify regression claim if target reduces pairs and timing at equal correctness, and only extreme synthetic occupancy is quadratic.

coverage_gaps: No runtime A/B timings or test runs were produced by this static audit. Parent runtime harness owns required scene matrix and GPU/presentation counters.

ZeroAllocJobScheduler 1.1.2 Schedule/Flush/Complete allocation was not independently decompiled or measured. Cached UnitStepJob objects and observer delegates remove visible per-step object creation, but package name does not prove 0 allocation.
Existing 1K/5K/10K candidate tests measure solver only and include single-worker dense cases; do not equate them with whole-frame FPS or worker allocation.
Only exact target source was read for findings. Historical blame records identify retained code lineage, not measured introduction of a regression.
Large model and native animation validation were a separate task; this file contains no evidence of duplicate visible draw.
baseline_explanation: Current origin/main already contains the target: origin/main...target is empty for the reviewed files. Reconstruct original PR changes against be8f0f69d2 (first parent of the merge), while reading all audited source from exact target.

measurement_issues.title: Navigation diagnostics overwrite samples by logic tick and are not a render-frame accumulator
measurement_issues.call_chain: GameEngine.Tick -> Pacemaker fixed-step loop -> PostMovement PreSimulationStep.Update -> SimulationRuntime.BeginFrame -> Telemetry.BeginFrame resets Last fields -> StepSystem writes latest navigation step samples -> PresentationTimingDiagnostics.ObserveMassNavigation assigns (=).
measurement_issues.behavior: A render frame with multiple fixed ticks can overwrite prior work. Last fixed tick without a nav step writes zero. A render frame with no fixed step can retain the previous diagnostics sample. Navigation Telemetry.FrameMs/Fps is calculated from fixed dt at 69-70, not wall-clock render duration.
measurement_issues.hard_pair_issue: Pair/candidate fields reset only inside ResolveHardPenetration:2447-2451, so a no-hard-step tick may expose previous hard counts. PendingEntitySyncCount is passed after SyncEntities cleared the list, usually 0; it is not number of writes performed.
missing_counters: true per-render-frame navigation step count and summed timings
measurement_issues.verification: Replay a host frame with 0,1,2+ fixed ticks and compare sum of instrumented invocations with existing Last fields. Record per-worker counters in preallocated slots and aggregate after jobs complete; avoid atomics on every pair.
measurement_issues.impact: Measurement correctness; does not establish a performance root cause.

runtime_event_capacity_notes.behavior: Agent property arrays, lists, HashSets and dictionaries reserve configured 160K agent capacity at construction. Therefore visible Array.Resize branches are not evidence of per10K-frame growth. Exceeding locked solver capacity throws before resize.

ResolveFlowStateIndex performs O(F) linear scan of team/layer combinations, not entity-to-agent lookup. It is used only on reset/append or changed runtime profile; unknown hot combination throws rather than allocating.
Agent-index to Entity sync lookup is direct List indexing O(1), not a linear entity search.

BindSpawnedAgent does direct world.Add and component checks on binding/event path. Separate binding audit must classify execution boundary; not evidence Step or SyncEntities does hot structural mutation.

Streaming window loops loaded chunks and uses preallocated dictionary/scratch (configured capacity256); overflow throws. Window shift scans N positions only when center changes. This bounded event/path has no confirmed 10K frame-time causation.
